title: REQ · Interactive objects support hover, label, click, actions and keyboard access
summary: Entities highlight on hover, show a name label, emit click events, expose a contextual action list and are keyboard operable.
description: Context: ObjectDef already carries interactionBounds, actions and visibleWhen; the typed bus defines objectHover and objectClick events. Desired behavior: SceneObject gets interaction bounds, hover tint plus name label, click emission, a contextual action list filtered by conditions, and keyboard focus cycling with Enter activation. Expected: hover and click events reach React through the existing phaserToReact bus. Why: acceptance requires accessible, clickable objects.
acceptance_criteria: Given pointerover, when it fires, then the object is tinted, its name label is shown and onHover(id) is called; on pointerout the tint clears, label hides and onHover(null) is called
Given pointerdown, when it fires, then onClick(id) is called once
Given actions with failing conditions, when listing, then only satisfied actions are returned
Given focus order [a,b,c], when next is pressed from c, then focus wraps to a and Enter triggers a click on the focused object
Given interactionBounds, when built, then setInteractive receives those bounds
technical_constraints: Objects without actions are not interactive
